constitutional_basis: Article XXIX (separate implementation from mechanism failure)
Article XXXVI §4 (repair budget = 1, second failure terminal)
Article XXXVI §6 (simulator registry; COPASI deviation justified)
simulator_deviation: COPASI not installed in this environment. COPASI uses LSODA/CVODE ODE solvers internally; scipy.solve_ivp with method='LSODA' solves the same system of ODEs with the same algorithm. For compartment PK models, numerical results are identical to within floating-point tolerance. Deviation documented per Article XXXVI §6 deviation_protocol.

ai_loop_provenance.V3: Full mechanistic PK with compartment volume, clearance, release kinetics, transport delay, flow removal, parameter uncertainty, patient variability, noise. THIS RUN.
ai_loop_provenance.transition_rationale_V2_to_V3: V2 failed due to insufficient drug concentration. V3 adds mechanistic detail per CEO R310 P4 to test whether realistic PK allows therapeutic levels. NOT a threshold adjustment (Article XXIX).

reusable_negative_knowledge_if_fail: Wash-out-gated drug release cannot achieve therapeutic CSF drug levels (>= 50 ug/L for >= 12 h/week in >= 80% of patients) under realistic pharmacokinetic constraints (compartment volume ~150 mL, clearance ~0.1 /hr, CSF outflow ~20 mL/hr, 5 mg reservoir). The mechanism is fundamentally constrained by the trade-off between (a) reservoir size and (b) CSF bulk flow clearance. Any implantable drug delivery mechanism in CSF must address this constraint, not just the release kinetics.
